name: Dog Face Mug
snippet: A whimsical mug that starts every morning with a smile.
story: I hand-sculpt every one of these — ears, snout, the whole personality. No two are exactly alike because I paint each one by hand. They make even Monday mornings something to look forward to, and they're my most popular gift item by far. Honestly, I'd keep every one I make.
details: 🎁 Great for: Dog lovers, birthdays, holidays
